If GO: define endgame core positioning (legacy echo vs sect inheritance coda)

Save design document

userStories.title: Design two endgame branches (if GO)

Save design document

Clarify endgame vs late-life vs patron/renown/magnate endgame

Save contract to docs/PRD/p118-founding-patriarch-endgame-contract.md

userStories.title: Define P119 validation shape

If NO-GO mark skipped with rationale
Save validation shape document
